items.html: And behold, what remained in him are the aspects of the crowns (Ketarim) of all the souls. And the matter is this: it has been explained that after he sinned, Adam did not merit the souls of Aba and Ima of Beria, but only from ZON and below. And these are ten Partzufim: ZON of Beria, and Aba and Ima and ZON of Yetzira, and Aba and Ima and ZON of Assiya. Now, every Partzuf comprises ten Sefirot, and each and every Sefira comprises ten within it; hence in every Partzuf are included a hundred Sefirot, and the ten among them are their crowns, which are: the crown within the crown, the crown within Hochma, the crown within Bina, etc. Thus, in every Partzuf there are ten crowns; and they are ten Partzufim, containing a hundred crowns. And these are the secret of the hundred cubits that remained in Adam HaRishon — being the crowns within all the souls — for the Klipot did not rule over them, as mentioned.
